Renovation — JLT, Dubai

A complete washroom renovation in JLT — stripped to the shell, replumbed and refitted with marble finishes, brass fittings and custom joinery, shown here from the original state to the design proposal and the finished room.

SectorRenovation
LocationJLT, Dubai
StatusDelivered
